title: Life Manager Cloud's 7-Day Free Trial: What Happens Each Day
markdown:
# Life Manager Cloud's 7-Day Free Trial: What Happens Each Day

Life Manager Cloud is $29/month after a 7-day free trial. Signup starts with Google identity only. No payment details are required at signup, and billing is set up in the web app after Calendar setup. This is what the seven days look like, stated from what the product page actually says.

## Day 0: the trial starts

The trial begins when you sign in with Google. Google sign-in verifies identity only. Signup does not require Calendar or Gmail inbox access, a task prompt, goals, budget, or payout details. The next step is Calendar setup in the web app. Billing setup comes after that, inside the web app.

## Days 1 to 3: the manager starts working

Life Manager is being built as one proactive manager for work, money, everyday responsibilities, body, and mind. It chooses useful priorities, carries work forward, and verifies outcomes — without a daily prompt. Calendar travel-time planning is one workflow inside that manager, not the product. Progress and verified results are designed to go to your sign-in email. By day 3, the check is simple: is Calendar setup done, so the manager has what it needs to work from?

## Days 4 to 6: earning work, stated honestly

The first Cloud earning workflow is being connected to Capafy. Capafy requires Publisher Certification and publisher confirmation of selected Skills and configuration before each Agent version can go live. Life Manager reports listings and earnings only after Capafy confirms them. The complete Cloud-to-Capafy path is still being verified, and earnings are not guaranteed. On day 6, check the billing settings in the web app, so you know exactly what happens when the trial ends.

## Day 7: the trial ends

The 7-day free trial ends on day 7. After the trial, Life Manager Cloud is $29/month. Price on the site: 29 USD. There is one plan on the site, not a tier list.

## What the trial does not ask for

The trial does not ask for payment details at signup, Calendar or Gmail inbox access at signup, a task prompt, goals, or a budget. It does not ask you to decide everything on day 0. It asks for Google identity, then Calendar setup in the web app, then billing setup in the web app.

## Start from the product page

If seven days with one manager for work, money, calendar, body and mind sounds useful, start from the product page, where the price, the trial, and the sign-up requirements are stated plainly:

- Life Manager: https://aniccaai.com/lm
- Life Manager Cloud, hosted on Maritime: https://aniccaai.com/maritime

One manager for your whole life.
